article.title: ‘Totally beyond the pale’: angry judge shuts down Trump administration’s mass destruction of DC trees
article.author: Editor
article.content: U.S. District Judge Ana Reyes said the Trump administration’s weekend removal of hundreds of trees at the East Potomac Golf Links “has cost the government all of its credibility.” The post ‘Totally beyond the pale’: angry judge shuts down Trump administration’s mass destruction of DC trees appeared first on MR Online .
